title: AgentService interface, types, and codec
description:
Implement the AgentService interface, request/response types, and AgentMessageRecord codec
from docs/plans/18-agent-loop-rpc.md.

Sections: 3 (AgentService Interface), 3.1 (Request/Response Types), 3.3 (AgentMessageRecord
Serialization Format), 3.4 (ResumeSession Validation rules — types only, not implementation),
5.5 first half (internal/agent/api/codec.go)

Key deliverables:
- internal/agent/api/agent.go — AgentService interface, EventReceiver interface
- internal/agent/api/agent_types.go — All request/response types, SessionConfig, ToolEnvironmentConfig,
  AgentMessageRecord, AgentSessionSummary
- internal/agent/api/codec.go — AgentMessageToRecord(), RecordToAgentMessage() with JSON schema
  per role (user, assistant, tool_result)
- Unit tests for codec round-trip fidelity (all roles, edge cases: empty content, multi-block,
  image blocks, tool_use blocks)

References:
- Plan: docs/plans/18-agent-loop-rpc.md §3, §3.1, §3.3, §5.5
- Test harness: docs/plans/18-agent-loop-rpc-test-harness.md §3 (P2: codec round-trip)
